parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — I’m sorry this is happening, especially with a Monday client launch deadline.

Based on what you shared, the project was deleted and then restored within the retention window, but some files and comments are still missing. That does sound like an incomplete/partial restore outcome, and this will require human review on our side.

To help our team investigate quickly, could you reply with the following details?
1) The project identifier (project name and/or project ID)
2) Which items are missing (how many files/comments, and any filenames/comment text you can list)
3) The exact delete and restore times (approximate is okay if you don’t have exact timestamps)
4) Whether the restore page/status shows “completed” (and any message shown)
5) Any errors you observed during restore (screenshots or the exact wording if available)
6) Confirm the affected platform/workspace (e.g., which product/service/environment) and where you performed the restore

Once we have that, we’ll escalate to the appropriate team to review the restore logs/asset state and advise on next steps as soon as possible.

If you can share the project ID and a short list of the missing deliverables first, that will let us prioritize immediately.
promised_actions: Request the minimum details needed to investigate the missing files/comments after restore
safety_notes: Do not promise a fix or recovery outcome
Do not mention refund or SLA

Support clicked restore within the retention window.
